spec.description: General OS performance metrics to assess the availability and performance of Linux and Windows systems. Leverages OpenTelemetry metrics collected with MetricsHub and stored in Prometheus.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  sum by (site, host_name, system_device) (
    system_filesystem_utilization_ratio{system_filesystem_state=~"used|reserved", system_filesystem_type!~"$filesystemFilter"}),
  "id", ":", "host_name", "system_device"
)
-
label_join(
  sum by (site, host_name, system_device) (
    system_filesystem_utilization_ratio{system_filesystem_state=~"used|reserved", system_filesystem_type!~"$filesystemFilter"} offset $__range
  ),
  "id", ":", "host_name", "system_device"
)

(
  count(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or 
  (0 * count by (host_name) (system_uptime_seconds)) # This is used to make sure a column is always created
)

(
  count(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or 
  (0 * count by (host_name) (system_uptime_seconds)) # This is used to make sure a column is always created
)

(
  # Case 1: Ping is down for selected OS types
  (max by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{protocol="ping"} == 0)) - 1
  or
  # Case 2: Ping is up for selected OS types → Show response time
  (max by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{protocol="ping"} == 1))
  * on(host_name)
  (max by (host_name) (metricshub_host_response_time_seconds{protocol="ping"}) * 1000)
)

spec.title: Unhealthy Hosts (%)
spec.description: Percentage of Hosts with at least one warning, one critical alert or one protocol down.

spec.expr:
100 * (
  count(
    group by (host_name) (
      (metricshub_host_up{os_type=~"$system"} == 0) or 
      (ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) or 
      (ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"})
    )
  ) 
  / 
  count(count by (host_name) (system_uptime_seconds))
)

(
  count(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or 
  (0 * count by (host_name) (system_uptime_seconds)) # This is used to make sure a column is always created
)

(
  count(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or 
  (0 * count by (host_name) (system_uptime_seconds)) # This is used to make sure a column is always created
)

spec.title: Unhealthy Hosts
spec.description: Number of Hosts with at least one warning, one critical alert or one protocol down.

spec.expr:
count(
  group by (host_name) (
    (metricshub_host_up{os_type=~"$system"} == 0) or 
    (ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) or 
    (ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"})
   )
)

100 * (
  count by (os_type) (
    group by (host_name, os_type) (
      (metricshub_host_up{os_type=~"$system"} == 0) or 
      ((ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity=~"critical|warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) 
       * on(host_name) group_left(os_type) 
       (group by (host_name, os_type) (system_uptime_seconds{os_type=~"$system"})))
    )
  ) 
  / 
  count by (os_type) (count by (host_name, os_type) (system_uptime_seconds{os_type=~"$system"}))
)
100 * count by (os_type) (group by (host_name, os_type) (system_uptime_seconds)) / scalar(count(count by (host_name) (system_uptime_seconds)))

count by (os_type) (
    group by (host_name, os_type) (
      (metricshub_host_up{os_type=~"$system"} == 0) or 
      ((ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity=~"critical|warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-System-.*"}) 
       * on(host_name) group_left(os_type) 
       (group by (host_name, os_type) (metricshub_host_up{os_type=~"$system"})))
    )
)

topk(5,
  max by (host_name, network_interface_name) (rate(system_network_io_bytes_total[$__range])) / on(host_name, network_interface_name)
  max by (host_name, network_interface_name) (system_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes)
)
